question: The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) focuses on:

options.text: Developing industrial clusters in backward regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enhancing development in underdeveloped districts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) was launched by the Government of India in **January 2018** under the auspices of NITI Aayog.
 
• It aims to rapidly transform **117 districts** identified as the most underdeveloped in India across various socio-economic indicators.
 
• The programme focuses on sectors such as **health and nutrition, education, agriculture and water resources, financial inclusion, and skill development**.
 
• ADP emphasizes **data-driven governance** through real-time monitoring and ranking of districts based on their progress in key indicators.
 
• Collaboration among central ministries, state governments, and district administrations ensures targeted interventions for accelerated development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog's Role:** NITI Aayog spearheads the Aspirational Districts Programme by providing technical support and monitoring the progress of districts using a **dashboard system**.
 
• **Delta Ranking:** Districts are ranked based on their improvement in key indicators. The ranking system encourages competition and accountability among districts.
 
• **Focus Areas:** The programme prioritizes development in areas such as **maternal and child health, education outcomes, rural infrastructure, and skill development**.
 
• **Convergence Model:** ADP integrates efforts from various schemes like **Poshan Abhiyaan, PM Awas Yojana, and Skill India Mission** to ensure holistic development.
 
• **UNDP Collaboration:** The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) supports the programme by identifying best practices and providing analytical assistance.
